Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Services

Conversion rate optimization services are how businesses get more revenue from the traffic they're already paying for — without increasing ad spend or redesigning everything at once. Every dollar you spend on traffic becomes more valuable when more of those visitors convert, and conversion rate optimization services are the most direct lever for improving that ratio. Agentix provides conversion rate optimization services for ecommerce stores, SaaS products, service business websites and lead generation landing pages — working from behavioral data, not guesswork. Whether you need ecommerce conversion optimization for a Shopify store, website conversion optimization for a service site, or ongoing CRO consulting, our CRO agency delivers measurable improvement. Our conversion rate optimization services combine analytics, heatmaps, session recording and structured A/B testing to identify and fix the friction points costing you conversions.

Why it matters

A store engineered to convert — not just to look good.

If you're an ambitious ecommerce brand, conversion rate optimization (cro) services should compound revenue at every visit. Here's what we help you achieve:

  • Lift conversion rate across mobile and desktop.
  • Cut friction from browse to checkout.
  • Build on a fast, scalable foundation that grows with you.

We combine conversion-first design, clean development and performance into stores that are a pleasure to use and built to scale.

What's included

Everything you get with Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Services.

01

CRO audit & analysis

Heatmaps, click maps, session recording analysis and funnel analytics review — building a behavioral data picture of exactly where visitors are dropping off and why. This is the foundation of both ecommerce conversion optimization and website conversion optimization — understanding the problem before solving it.

02

A/B testing program

Structured hypothesis testing of page layouts, copy, calls-to-action, form design and checkout flow — with proper statistical rigor, minimum sample sizes and significance thresholds before declaring winners.

03

Landing page optimization

High-converting landing page design and copy refinement — for paid traffic, organic campaigns and product launches — with ongoing iteration based on performance data.

04

Form & lead capture optimization

Form length, field labels, trust signals and confirmation flow optimized to maximize completion rate without sacrificing lead quality.

05

Mobile UX optimization

Full mobile experience audit and improvement — because mobile visitors convert at lower rates on most websites, and fixing mobile UX is typically the single highest-impact CRO lever.

06

Page speed CRO

Performance improvements targeting the direct revenue impact of faster load times — because slow pages have high bounce rates and low conversion rates regardless of how good the design is.

How it works

A clear path from audit to growth.

Step 01

Audit

Analytics review, heatmap deployment, session recording analysis — data collection before touching anything.

Step 02

Hypothesize

Converting data findings into prioritized, testable hypotheses ranked by expected revenue impact.

Step 03

Test

A/B tests run with statistical rigor — correct sample sizes, significance thresholds and test duration.

Step 04

Implement

Winners implemented; learnings fed into the next test cycle for compounding improvement.

Questions

Good to know.

It depends heavily on industry and traffic source. Ecommerce average is 1.5–3%, with top performers hitting 4–5%+. Lead generation pages average 2–5%. SaaS free trial pages average 3–8%. The most important metric is your own conversion rate trend — is it improving or declining?

Statistically valid A/B testing requires sufficient traffic — typically 500–1,000+ visitors per variant per test. For lower-traffic sites, we use qualitative CRO methods: expert heuristic review, heatmaps and session analysis to make high-confidence improvements without waiting for statistical significance.

UX design creates the user experience. CRO tests and refines it based on behavioral data. Good CRO is built on good UX thinking, but proves its hypotheses with real user behavior rather than design intuition alone.

Yes. Expert CRO review, heatmap analysis and session recording analysis often reveal clear, high-confidence fixes — broken form fields, unclear CTAs, trust signal gaps, mobile layout failures — that don't require A/B testing to justify implementing. We start with what's obviously broken before running structured tests.
